objective: Qualify the risk basis for a diligence decision on fictional Sedge Credit.

sources.title: Origination materials
sources.extract: Sedge Credit Ltd says PAR30 is 2% and presents a partner's licence as proof that Sedge itself can originate credit in the stated jurisdiction.

sources.title: Dated portfolio schedule
sources.extract: At the cut-off, gross outstanding principal is USD 1,000,000 and USD 120,000 in outstanding principal is on loans more than 30 days past due. That balance excludes fees. Year charge-offs USD 45,000, recoveries USD 5,000 and average gross principal USD 800,000.

sources.title: Fictional public register excerpt
sources.extract: The attached licence names Bracken Finance PLC. The packet contains no register record authorising Sedge Credit Ltd, and no signed origination or risk-transfer agreement.

questions.question: Give portfolio-at-risk over 30 days as a percentage number.
Give (charge-offs less recoveries) / average gross principal as a percentage number.
Classify the asserted 2% PAR30 as supported, contradicted, different_basis, or unknown.
Give the evidenced own-entity licence reference for Sedge Credit Ltd or null.
Give the legal entity actually named on the attached licence.

priority_options.AUTHORITY: Own-entity authorisation evidence and signed origination/risk-transfer terms.
priority_options.VINTAGES: Matched age buckets and follow-up vintage cash collection.
